summary: The First Den is a forest world centered on Spawn, with the owner's home and grounds, lake and wizard tower connected by authored highways to Lumenvale and Hearthmere. Terrain marks and procedural builders shape the landscape and cities; shared player interactions, mounts, courier rides and travel connect its places.
places: places/main - the configured forest world: Spawn/home, lake and wizard tower, highways, Lumenvale east and walled Hearthmere west
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn hub: home and grounds, creek, lake/dock, wizard tower, Violet and mount pads, rowboat; also contains blueprint layout boxes for several grounds additions
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - neighboring shore/forest cell with fox and fauna, maze and deer fencing; shore-dressing is a blueprint placeholder
places/main/cells/objects.scene - shared placements including road dressing and authored Hearthmere/Lumenvale city structures
places/main/cells/*.scene - fixed structures, actors and relationships distributed across main's streamed cells
places/main/config.yaml - forest terrain, path/clearing/flattening marks and decoration bindings; grades road corridors and city approaches
roots: world.config.yaml - world defaults, player/camera templates, input actions, lighting, arrival and UI
templates/player.js#player - player movement, locomotion, home interaction, delete mode and travel behaviors
places/main/config.yaml - forest terrain, river, site/path marks, clearing and seeded vegetation
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#cob-house - procedural multi-level home around the tree, cellar through roof deck
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#purple-dragon-blueprint and #lake-rowboat - Violet's mount home and the lake's mountable boat
scripts/gen/hearth-city.js and scripts/gen/lumen-grand.js - procedural builder entry points used by authored city rows
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - main heightAt/materialAt(ctx) contract for terrain and terrain-relative placements
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - seeded vegetation builders reused by decoration layers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js - shared solid geometry for bridges and roadside features
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and interaction tuning
scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - mount request, seat, dismount and camera handoff shared by Violet, rowboat and courier horse
scripts/lib/data/hearth-city.js - Hearthmere district, avenue, canal and layout data consumed by hearth-city builder
scripts/lib/data/travel.js - shared destination list/tuning read by travel behavior and UI
scripts/lib/data/courier.js - courier row IDs, city routes/destinations and ride tuning read by courier, player interaction and UI
notableExports: scripts/forest-terrain.js - GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx)
scripts/player.js - onSpawn(ctx), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber(value,fallback), update(ctx,dt)
scripts/gen/hearth-city.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); scripts/gen/lumen-grand.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx)
scripts/courier.js - update(ctx,dt), ears.press and ears.courierRide; scripts/travel.js - onInput(ctx,input)
scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - wantMount(ctx,target), dragonRide(ctx); scripts/home-player-feel.js - player interaction handlers
scripts/ui.js - HUD including courier picker/status and travel list; templates/player.js#player attaches scripts/travel.js
scripts/purple-dragon.js - Violet mount behavior; scripts/gen/purple-dragon.js - dragon geometry/collider; scripts/rowboat.js - boat behavior
scripts/gen/grand-gate.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); scripts/grand-gate-leaf.js - update(ctx,dt); world.facts.yaml maps anim/fox.yml#alert to its authored clip
ownership: places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - terrain seed/material/site marks, scatter and derived ground height/material; marks grade roads, lawns, creek and clearings
places/main/cells/*.scene - authored row IDs, positions, tags, initial state and fixed structure/actor relationships
scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - player movement intent, velocity, jump, flight and rope behavior; high-frequency scratch in ctx.session
scripts/home-player-feel.js - player seat/mount requests and courier picker state courierPick; scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js coordinates mountWant, mountedOn and rider seating handoff
scripts/courier.js + scripts/lib/data/courier.js - horse route/ride phase, rider, seat, dropAt and return; place.state.courier announces busy city/rider
scripts/travel.js + scripts/lib/data/travel.js - player travelOpen/travelAt and destination definitions; UI renders but does not own these states
scripts/purple-dragon.js + scripts/lib/data/purple-dragon.js - Violet flight/rider/home state; scripts/rowboat.js + rowboat data - boat motion and interaction tuning
scripts/ui.js - rendered HUD presentation from player state, place courier state and shared destination/tuning data
flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain, river channels and forest material bands
places/main/config.yaml site/path/river marks + decoration layers -> terrain clearing, grading, lawn material and seeded vegetation; scene rows separately draw visible roads and structures
road-east/road-west and city path marks -> graded terrain corridors and scatter clearing; authored cells place road fences, lamps, bridges and city geometry
move/look/jump/camView input -> scripts/player.js -> movement, jump, flight and camMode; place gravity applies to player body
interact press -> scripts/home-player-feel.js -> nearest seat/mount or aligned press; pet press writes petAt/petBy for fauna and other responders
player mountWant -> scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js -> mounted entity seat/rider state and parent transform; mount behavior controls step-off and camera restoration
violet-pad pressTo -> scripts/purple-dragon.js -> Violet rest/ride/tour/landing phases; dragon-rider seats player and purple-dragon-clips supplies animation
mounted player input -> scripts/rowboat.js + rowboat data -> boat motion, water handling and shore dismount
horse press -> scripts/courier.js ears.press -> player.state.courierPick and greeting; home-player-feel handles city/cancel input and emits courierRide to horse
courierRide -> scripts/courier.js reads road-<city> terrain mark at ride time -> route movement and ground sampling -> rider dropAt at gate; place.state.courier informs nearby UI
player presses J / destination action -> scripts/travel.js onInput -> travel data destination, terrain height and teleport; scripts/ui.js displays list/status and emits travelGo

grand-gate-leaf-a/b proximity -> scripts/grand-gate-leaf.js -> each kinematic leaf swings on its own keyed ctx.session.leaf state and emits wrought-iron open/close sounds; scripts/gen/grand-gate.js supplies leaf geometry/collider
behaviorFamilies: places/main/config.yaml decoration layers + scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-mesh.js - seeded forest plants, trees, shrubs, ferns, reeds and lawn flora varied by layer, kind and terrain
scripts/gen/cob-house.js + scripts/gen/cob-furnish.js - tree-centered multi-level cob home and furnishing family; parameters select item, dimensions, palette and seeded detail
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - reusable bridge geometry/collider varied by dimensions and seed
scripts/gen/deer-fence.js - perimeter runs and gates vary by points, width and style; stone style builds coursed limestone wall, coping, moss/ivy and piers

scripts/gen/animal-{bear,deer,fox,wolf}.js + fauna-ground.js and scripts/gen/critter-{bird,duck,rabbit,squirrel}.js + fauna-small.js - shared large/small fauna behavior varied by species, geometry and animation
scripts/gen/hearth-city.js + scripts/lib/data/hearth-city.js - Hearthmere wall, gatehouse, keep, districts, avenue and canal; layout and district data drive a single assembled city builder
scripts/gen/lumen-grand.js - Lumenvale grand structures, canal and procedural lots varied by kind, parameters and layout
scripts/gen/grand-gate.js + scripts/grand-gate-leaf.js - limestone gate frame and independently swinging wrought-iron leaves varied by width, direction and leaf state
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene behavior row attaches this actor script; scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry may still be used
migrationNotes: forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main's river is at sea level y=0, ground is around y=0.5, and Spawn clearing is centered near (0,-3).

Keep places/main/config.yaml material IDs, clear/flatten marks and decoration bindings coordinated with scene placement; Spawn/home grounds are around (0,-27), while picnic, quad garden, wizard tower and cities are separate sites.
Configured terrain path marks grade/materialize roads and clear scatter; scene path generators draw visible paving and do not replace the terrain jobs.
The den-creek follows authored river points through Spawn under creek-bridge-avenue toward the back pond; keep den-creek-banks and creek-banks dressing aligned separately.
Courier routes read road-<city> marks at ride time; keep COURIER city keys/road names, road mark names and destination centers coordinated. Courier owns place.state.courier while horse is away.

Grand-gate-leaf-a and -b share ctx.session.leaf as a map keyed by row id; preserve separate swing state for each leaf. x0z0/x0z-1 rows tagged blueprint use engine/blueprint with physics none and are layout placeholders, not functional scene geometry.
